remarks: This charming two-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo is located just minutes from the center of town. The newly renovated kitchen is fresh, bright, and thoughtfully designed, with an easy flow into the living and dining areas. The private outdoor deck extends the living space and is an ideal spot for morning coffee or gathering with friends for dinner outside. The two bedrooms offer comfortable, private spaces, while the fully finished lower level provides flexible additional space for a family room, home office, gym, or guest area. With a full bath and laundry on this level, it adds both functionality and convenience. A detached one-car garage provides private parking and extra storage. Turnkey and ideally situated within the well-maintained Graystone Circle complex, this condo offers exceptional convenience, flexibility, and easy living just minutes from town.
